tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo'i man ngag don thams cad yongs su grub pa mkhas pa'i rna rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gang mtshan zla snang 'char tsam gyis// 'jigs bcas gdung ba kun bsal nas// phan bde bdud rtsi'i mchog sbyin pa// so sor 'brang mas dge legs mdzod// gang de'i 'khor lo'i man ngag ni// 'chang bas don kun 'grub byed pa// gzungs dang mkhas pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// blo ldan rna ba'i rgyan du dgod// de'ang 'di ltar rjes su thos te/ bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum 'phags ma rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga las/ gsum pa rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i gzungs ni/ ston pa rdo rje lhun po chen po'i zom khang brtsegs rdo rje chen po'i sa gzhir rdo rje'i seng khri la bzhugs te 'khor skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa na smin mtshams nas 'od bkye ste/ zhing thams cad snang bar byas nas 'khor la rig sngags kyi phan yon gsungs te rig sngags rgyas par bka' stsal/ de nas rig sngags kyi phan yon sgra gcan zin bzang po rig pa 'di yid la byas pas mes ma tshugs pa dang*/ tshong dpon mdzod stobs can gyi bu klu 'jog po'i dug gis zin pa dge bsnyen dri ma med pas rig pa 'di brjod pas nye bar zhi ba dang*/ rgyal po tshangs pas byin rig pa'i rgyal mo spyi bor btags pas pha rol gyi dmag tshogs las rgyal ba dang*/ dge slong bslab pa dral zhing mi dge ba mang du spyad pa dge bsnyen zhig gis rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di bris te mgul du btags pas nad las grol zhing mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba las grol te sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i nang du skyes pa dang*/ tshong dpon dri med dung gis rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags pas rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs pa las thar pa dang*/

rgyal po lag brkyang gis btsun mo dam pa'i mgul du btags pas bu med pa'i sdug bsngal las grol ba dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis spyi bor btags pas lha ma yin gyi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar pa bcas gsungs nas/ snying po/ nye snying*/ rab tu gsang ba'i snying po phan yon dang bcas pa gsungs te/ 'dis ston pa rgya cher rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal las nyid kyis lan bdun brjod pas bdud thams cad bcom pa dang*/ rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyis chad pas bcad pa'i 'phags rgyal ba'i mi zhig gis yid la dran pas gshed ma dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ chu'i 'jig pas ma tshugs shing rgyal po'i chad pa las grol ba'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ srung ba'i cho ga rig sngags phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ nad gso ba'i cho ga phan yon dang bcas pa gsungs so// de ltar rig sngags sde tshan gsum gyi dang po'i skabs/ bram ze chen po gang la la zhig rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma chen mo 'di cho ga bzhin du bris te lag pa'am/ mgul du btags na de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par rig par bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur rig par bya'o// rdo rje'i lus yin par rig par bya'o// de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi snying po can yin par rig par bya'o// de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan yin par rig par bya'o// de rdo rje chen po'i lus su rig par bya'o// de 'bar ba 'od 'phro ba'i lus dang ldan par rig par bya'o// de mi shigs pa'i go cha can du rigs par bya'o// de dgra thams cad rab tu 'joms par rig par bya'o// de sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad 'joms par rig par bya'o// de sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba rnams sbyong bar rig par bya'o// zhes mtshams sbyar te dge slong ngan 'gro las grol ba'i tshul rgyas par gsungs pa'i mjug tu/

de tshe der ni de dag gis// rgyal po'i pho brang nye ba na// sgang bu de yi khor yug na// 'bar ba gcig gis gang bar mthong*// mi ro zhig gi mgul pa na// so sor 'brang ba btags pa'ang mthong*// lha dang klu dang dri za dang*// gnod sbyin srin po mi 'am cis// kun nas 'khor bar bskor nas ni// bla na med pa'i mchod pa byed// de la gnod sbyin de dag gis// so sor 'brang ba'i sgang zhes btags// zhes gsungs/ de'ang dge slong sdig pa sna tshogs byed pa de 'chi nad tshabs po ches btab pa na/ dge bsnyen zhig gis so sor 'brang ba 'di mgul tu btags pas nad 'phral du zhi/ dran pa shin tu nye bar bzhag ste 'chi ba'i dus byas pa na de ma thag tu sdig pa'i mthus mnar med pa'i dmyal bar skyes/ ro de sgang bu zhig la bzhag nas so sor 'brang ma'ang mgul du btags bzhin pa'i byin rlabs kyis mnar med kyi me rang zhi nas sems can dmyal ba pa kun kyang bde ba dang ldan par gyur/ de gshin rje'i mi rnams kyis chos kyi rgyal po la brjod pas/ gshin rje'i rgyal po so sor 'brang ma btags pa'i mthu yin pa'i tshul rgyas par bsnyad cing*/ gang gis tshig rnams so sor dran// de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur// so sor 'brang ba sgom pa yi// shes rab can de bde 'gror 'gro// sems can dmyal ba'i srung ma khyed// rab tu chas dang ldan par dong*// der ni sgang bu mthon po na// lha rnams kyis ni bskor ba ltos// sogs bskul bas de rnams song ba na gong du smos pa bzhin mthong bas ngo mtshar zhing*/ dge slong de sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lhar skyes tshul shin tu rgyas par gsungs so// yang rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyi lo rgyus skabs/ rgyal po tshangs pas byin spos chu sna tshogs kyis mgo bkrus te/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di cho ga bzhin du bris te mgo'i gtsug gi sgra'i nang du bzhag ste/

rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di nyid kyi go cha byas te g.yul gyi nang du zhugs pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyis g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul dang*/ tshong dpon dri med dung gi lo rgyus las 'phros nas 'di nyid rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags na rlung dang*/ grang ba dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i sprin dang*/ glog dang*/ lce 'babs pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'thab rtsod thams cad las thar ba dang*/ lo tog la 'tshe ba'i srog chags thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gcan gzan sogs kyi 'jigs pa dang bral ba dang*/ me tog dang*/ lo ma dang*/ sman dang*/ 'bras bu rnam par 'phel ba dang*/ char chu dus su 'bebs pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas par gsungs shing*/ yang 'di skad du/ yul gang na rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma chen mo zhes bya ba 'di spyod pa'i yul der sems can de dag gis shes par bya ste/ spos sna tshogs dang*/ bdug pa sna tshogs dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis mchod cing bsti stang byas la/ tshon sna tshogs kyis dkris te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags nas glu dbyangs dang*/ rol mo sil snyan byas te bskor ba byas na lha rnams dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i sems can chen po de dag gis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ bu pho 'dod na'ang khye'ur 'grub// mngal na 'dzin pa dam par 'gyur// mngal na bde bar skye ba dang*// mngal nas bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur// mngal na dus bzhin skye ba dang*// dus bzhin rab tu btsa' bar 'gyur// zhes pas mtshams sbyar te rgyal po lag brkyang gi lo rgyus dang*/ rgyu skar gyi rgyal po rgyal gyi nyin par btsun mo dam pa lus shin tu legs par bkrus te/ smyung ba byas nas rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ma 'di yang cho ga bzhin du bris te btsun mo dam pa de'i mgul du btags so// sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten rnams la mchod pa chen po bya'o// rin po che khyad par can du ma yang sems can rnams la sbyin pa byin no// zhes 'byung ngo*// rig sngags sde tshan gnyis pa'i mjug tu/

de ltar na rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di yongs su shes te/ gang du yang thogs pa med de/ de lta bas na gdon mi za bar rtag tu lus la gdags shing bcang bar bya'o// bram ze chen po skar ma bzang po la cho ga legs par byas te rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di bri bar bya'o// de nas bram ze chen po de yid rab tu dga' nas bcom ldan 'das la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal nas zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di'i cho ga ji ltar bgyis te bri bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze chen po khyod nyon cig sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir// ngas ni khyod la bshad par bya// gang gis sems can bde byed cing*// nyam nga ba yi nad las grol// nad rnams las kyang thar bya dang*// bud med sbrum mar 'gyur ba dang*// sems can rnams kyi dbul ba yi// rma rnams gso bar bya phyir ro// zhes dgos pa dang*/ bsnyen gnas dag la gnas gyur pas// zhes gang zag dang*/ rgyu skar rgyal du shes pa la// zhes dus dang*/ sangs rgyas mchod la brtson byas te// byang chub phyir ni sems kyang bskyed// snying rjes kun tu brten sems dang*// byams pa dang yang ldan gyur nas// rtag tu sems can thams cad la// phan pa bskyed par brtson par bya// zhes bsam pa dang*/ tsan+dan dang ni gur gum dang*// gla rtsir bsres pa'i chus bkrus te// bdug pa rnams kyis bdugs pa yi// gos gtsang rnams ni bgo bar bya// zhes sngon du bya ba dang*/ sa la lci ba bsres pa yi// de yi 'og tu dkyil 'khor bya// zhes sogs dkyil 'khor bya ba'i tshul rgyas par gsungs na'ang*/ da lta sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar byas na des khyab par snang*/ kha zas dkar po zos nas su// phan par 'dod pas bri bar bya// zhes kun spyod dang*/ dar ram ras sam gro ga'am// ci yang rung ba gzhan la bri// zhes bri gzhi dang*/ bud med dag la bu 'dod na// gi'u wang dag gis legs par bri// dbus su khye'u zhig bris nas/

rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan// de bzhin rin chen gang ba'i snod// lag pa g.yon na thogs par bya// pad+ma rab tu rgyas gyur cing*// brgyan pa la ni de 'dug bya// nor bu do shal gser dag dang*// rin chen sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan// gdul bar shin tu dka' ba bri// grwa bzhi dag tu ri bo bri// gal te bde bar 'tsho 'dod na// rab tu bsgrims te de ltar bri// bye brag tu ni skyes pa rnams// gur gum gyis ni bri bar bya// de yi dgos pa 'dod pa rnams// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// pad+ma gnyis sam yang na gsum// bzhi 'am yang na lnga bris te// pad+ma la ni phyag rgya'i mtshan// rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs su bri// zhes sogs ji ltar 'bri ba'i tshul spyi dang*/ dge slong phyir ni rdo rje 'chang*// gnod sbyin bsdigs par brtson pa bri// rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyang*// ngos bzhi rnams su bri bar bya// zhes sogs bye brag gi 'bri tshul rgyas par gsungs/ 'di la rgyal rigs la dbang phyug dmangs rigs la rtag zhi ba dang*/ khyab 'jug rje'u rigs kyi phyir rnam thos kyi bu dang*/ lha'i dbang phyug dbang po sogs bri bar gsungs/ cho ga bzhin du nges bris la// blo gros ldan pa'i mis bsrel na// za ma dang ni ma ning yang*// bu pho rnyed par 'gyur ba yin// 'dis ni thams cad 'grub par byed// shis shing sdig pa zhi bar byed// rang byung gi ni bka' bzhin du// gnas kyi dam pa thob par 'gyur// 'jig rten 'di na mchog tu bde// 'jig rten pha rol shin tu bde// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas la sogs// lha gnas de yis gnas su 'gyur// 'dzam gling bzang zhing nyams dga' bar// khyad par can rigs grags pa dang*// rgyal rigs khyad par 'phags pa dang*// bram ze khyad par 'phags rnams su// bdag nyid chen po de skyes te// rtag tu rig dang bde bar 'gyur// so sor 'brang ba 'chang ba'i mis// bsod nams thob pa gang yin pa// sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyis// bsod nams phung po brjod mi nus// sems can dmyal ba'i sgo rnams bcad// mtho ris sgo rnams rab tu phye// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang*// blo gros chen por 'gyur ba yin// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas kyang*// rtag tu dbugs ni 'byin par 'gyur// lus kyi bde ba phun sum tshogs// stobs kyang che bar 'gyur ba yin// rgyal bas ji skad gsungs pa ltar// 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ba yin// mi dang lha rnams dgug 'byin te// gnod par sems pa skrag par byed// gang phyir rig pa legs bshad pa// de ni ring por mi thogs so// de ni mtshon gyis mi tshugs te// dug dang mes kyang tshugs mi 'gyur// dus min 'chi ba'i sdig pa yang*// de la thag ni ring du 'gro// rnam pa kun tu nyan pa'am// mthong ba dang ni rig pa'ang rung*// 'byung po gdon dang rtsod pa dang*// chu dang me yis 'jigs pa dang*// gcan gzan sbrul dang seng ge dang*// klu dang nad ni mi bzad rnams// gang la rigs pa legs bshad pa// de la de dag kun mi 'byung*// de dag sems can kun mchog 'gyur// bdud rnams kun gyis thams cad du// mchod par 'gyur ba'i 'os yin te// yang dag bshad kyis mnyan par byos// zhes phan yon rgya cher bsngags so// rig sngags sde tshan gsum pa rdzogs pa'i mjug tu/

nad pa rnams ni gso bya ba// da ni rab tu bshad par bya// zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ sa dang lci ba bsres pa yis// dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa bya// sogs dkyil 'khor bya ba'i tshul dang*/ de yi 'og tu nad pa yang*// dri zhim spos kyis lus bskus te// gtsang ma'i gos rnams bskon nas ni// dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag par bya// de nas shar phyogs kha bstan te// rig pa 'di ni brjod par bya// lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas su// mkhas pas de la bsrung bar bya// de nas nad pa'i don gyi phyir// lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu// rig pa 'di ni brjod byas na// des ni nad kun zhi bar 'gyur// zhes nad pa gso ba'i cho ga'i dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug tu gtor ma lho/ nub/ byang*/ 'og steng rnams su gtang bar gsungs so// rig sngags sde tshan dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ nas/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te badz+re swā hā/ bar/ sde tshan gnyis pa/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ te nas/ rab tu gsang ba'i snying po'i// bar/ sde tshan gsum pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bar ro/

sde spar bka' 'gyur ltar na rgyud glegs bam/ ba/ ba gzungs grwa lnga'i ldeb/ 121 nas/ 136 bar ci rigs su khyon ldeb phyed bzhi yod pas mtshon// ༈ /so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo'i bri yig bzhugs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i rgyal mo la phyag btsal nas/ 'dir so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo bri bar bya'o// de la bdag gis mthong ba na/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī las mdzad pa/ shān+ti pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīr+t+tis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīr+t+tis mdzad pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa ste lugs mang du snang ba mi mthun par snang*/ 'di paṇa chen shākya shrīs rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang gi shar sgo'i steng na bris nas snang ba la zhal bshus nas byon par mthong na'ang*/ cung mi gsal bar 'dug pas phyi rabs kyi don du gsal bar bkod pa'o// ji ltar mthong ba'i rjes 'brangs nas// de yi 'khor lo'i mtshan nyid bshad// mtshan ma sngags dang ldan pa yi// rim pa bcu gnyis bskor ba yis// dbus dang bzhi pa sor bzhi bya// gnyis gsum lnga drug bdun brgyad ni// sor re lnga pa cung zad che// dgu pa bcu pa bcu gcig pa// bcu gnyis pa rnams sor gnyis pa// gur gum gi waṃ dri bzangs kyis// shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas bri// lte ba dang bzhi pa'i phyogs bzhir pad+ma'i nang du pram̐ gi khog par/ oṃ ma ṇi bha ri badz+ra ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa gnyis gnyis so// mu khyud nang ma la ma ṇi dha ri bri/ de'i phyi ma la/ oṃ ye dharmāḥhe tu pra bha wā he tu n+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba datra/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ pā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ bri/ de'i phyi ma la pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi dang*/

rdo rje rgya gram mo// pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i shar nas rim pa bzhin/ oṃ a mṛ ta stong chen rab 'byams/ ba re wa ra wa ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba po la zhes so// lhor/ oṃ a mṛ ta rma bya chen mo/ bi lo ke ni gar+bhe saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi ā kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nub tu/ oṃ bi ma le gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ bi pu le dza ya wa re a mṛ ta bi ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ byang du/ oṃ bha ra bha bsil ba'i tshal/ ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+ra ya ba la bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba po la nad gdon shān+tiṃ ku ru/ tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes so// shar lhor rdo rje'i dbus kyi rwa la oṃ a mṛ ta bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa sogs/ lho nub la/ oṃ bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nub byang la/ oṃ bi ma le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ byang shar la/ oṃ dza ya wa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba zhes so// phyi'i rwa brgyad la/ oṃ ni suṃ bha badz+ri ṇi dha ra ka s+ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa bri/ pram̐ lnga'i phyogs bzhir re rer hūm̐ gnyis gnyis bri/ de'i phyi ma lnga pa pad+ma nyer lnga'i nang du hrīḥtshig drag dang bcas pa nyer lnga bri'o// de'i phyi drug pa la/ oṃ a pa ra dzi te ma hā de bī traṭa/ oṃ kā la kar+ṇi kṛta/ oṃ pad+ma kuṇ+ḍa li baṃ/ oṃ puṣ+pa dan+ti ni hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇ+yaṃ ku shi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shṛṃ kha le hūm̐/ oṃ shwe te bam̐/ oṃ ma hā shwe te hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā li hrīḥ oṃ dū ti tu ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī le hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra pā she hoḥ oṃ badzā be she bhṛ ta/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā ba le dhiḥ oṃ badz+ra ma le māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa bh+yoḥ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i phye bdun pa la/ oṃ tsuṇ+ḍe hrīḥ oṃ su waṇ+ṇa ke shi kritra/ oṃ piṃ ga le lam̐/ oṃ bing+yun+ma li ni dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ shān+ti ka ri hūm̐/ oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ba la war+d+dha ni haḥ oṃ sum+bha ka ri hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa mā la dha ri hrīḥ oṃ ma hā pra ti sa re pram̐/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ hu ru hu ru/ oṃ baṃ la bar+d+dha ni ye hoḥ oṃ ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re 'chang ba po la/ de'i phyi brgyad pa la/ oṃ tā re tāṃ/ oṃ dzaḥ oṃ rak+ṣa saṃ ka dza ṭe kham̐/ oṃ bud+dha rak+ṣi ni he hūm̐/ oṃ ka pā li ni hūm̐/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri kham̐/ oṃ dha n+ye lam̐/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri mum̐/ oṃ hā ri tī hām̐ k+ṣīm̐/ oṃ pañtsi ke dzam̐/ oṃ li khi sham̐ ruṭa/ oṃ kuṭa dan+ti ni kuṭa/ oṃ shī yā de bī shrīṃ/ oṃ sa ra swa tī bam̐/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ 'chang ba po la sarba rak+ṣa/ sarba bha ye bh+yo bh+rūm̐/ oṃ de bī shrī/ oṃ pad+me pām̐/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ lo tsa ne lām̐/ oṃ mā ma kī mām̐/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa re pam̐/ oṃ ba su dha ri bam̐/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ oṃ bh+ri ku ṭi bh+riṃ/ hūm̐ bhūm̐ aḥ de'i phyi rim dgu pa la rdo rje dang pad+ma phyogs re re bdun bdun nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ de'i pad+ma'i nang du/ oṃ sa/ su sha/ pa lam̐/ k+ṣa k+ṣa/ dhu e/ ta brūm̐/ ka kha/ ha bam̐/ dzi bam̐/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ra hūm̐/ lam̐ hrīḥ sum̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥbam̐/ su hūm̐/ oṃ phaṭ/ dzaḥbam̐/ mām̐ ka bam̐ oṃ/ su bha/ bam̐ oṃ/ tri k+ṣa/ ha dham̐/ sham̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ sam̐/ hūm̐/ ho oṃ/ de'i phyi rim bcu pa'i pad+ma'i nang du phyag mtshan/ rin po che/ 'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan/ mda'/ gzhu/ phur pa/ dug mi mgo rdo rje/ gdugs/ dpal be'u/ tho ba/ rtse gsum/ chu gri/ gri gug ral gri/ rgya gram/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ nya/ bum pa/ pad+ma/

dbyug to/ mdung*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ lnga/ drug brgyad/ brag ri/ gtun shing rnams la dar gyi lda ldis brgyan pa bri'o// de'i phyi ru bcu gcig pa la phyogs re rer pad+ma bcu bzhir ste lnga bcu rtsa drug la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ri rī/ li lī/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ rten 'brel snying po bri'o// de'i phyi ru rdo rje nyal ba kha dog mi gcig pa bri'o// de'i phyi ru me ri bri'o// shar lho zur la mu khyud lte ba la gnyis/ phyi la gcig lte ba la tā+e/ bar ma la oṃ ka s+ya rak+ṣa swā hā/ rak+ṣa dha ra 'chang ba/ phyi ma pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ tā/ re/ tutra/ tāṃ/ ri/ tu/ re/ swā/ hā/ phyi rim me ri kun la 'dra'o// g.yas kyi pad+ma bzhi pa pad+ma 'dab bzhi ste/ lte ba la hūm̐/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ sam̐/ gam̐/ bh+rām̐/ e/ g.yon du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la oṃ/ 'dab ma la/ mā/ rī/ ts+yai/ mām̐/ hūm̐/ phaṭa/ swā hā/ lho nub zung la/ mu khyud lte bar gcig phyi la gnyis/ lte ba la hūm̐/ rtsibs bzhi la/ oṃ/ dz+rim̐/ kham̐/ hūm̐/ mu khyud la/ oṃ nī lā wā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rādzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ dha ra ka s+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ 'chang ba po la/ g.yas 'dab bzhi'i lte ba la mam̐/ 'dab ma la tsa gam̐/ hūm̐/ bam̐/ pam̐/ g.yon pad+ma 'dab drug la/ lte bar dhīḥ 'dab ma la/ oṃ/ a/ ra/ pa/ tsa/ na'o// nub byang gi zur la mu khyud gnyis/ lte ba la/ oṃ ka s+ya rak+ṣa dha ra rak+ṣa phaṭa/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ tsaṇ+ḍa/ ma/ hā/ ro/ ṣa/ ṇa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa/ g.yas kyi lte ba la oṃ/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ pram̐/ gam̐/ hūm̐/ sam̐/ g.yon gyi 'khor lo rtsibs lnga la lte bar oṃ/ rtsibs lnga pa ma/ ṇi/ pad/ me/ hūm̐/ byang shar lte ba gcig mu khyud la gnyis kyi lte ba la oṃ/ rtsibs brgyad la/ oṃ/ mam̐/ dzam̐/ pram̐/ kham̐/ tam̐/ bh+rūm̐/ lam̐/ mu khyud la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/

'chang ba po la gnod pa thams cad srungs shig g.yas su lte ba la gam̐/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ dza/ bam̐/ yam̐/ mam̐/ g.yon gyi lte ba la bam̐ hūm̐/ rtsibs brgyad la/ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ a/ a/ bri'o// de'i phyi rim la shar gyi g.yas su/ oṃ badz+ra krodha hūm̐ gtsug tor 'khor lo/ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yon tu oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza rnam sar rgyal ba/ ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho'i zur la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la dbyug sngon can/ daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka gshin rje gshed/ hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub tu/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa mi g.yob la hūm̐ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub g.yas su/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya rta mgrin/ grī wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yon du/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba 'og gi stobs po che/ la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ lī hūm̐ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar du/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya 'jig rten gsum rgyal/ bi dza ya hūm̐ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di ltar mi 'dri bar zur bzhi la rdo rje phyed pa bri ba/ la lar bum pa/ la lar ri gzugs/ la lar rgyal chen bzhi/ la lar bkra shis rtags brgyad bri ba yang mthong zhing*/ mang po'ang snang yang 'di zab par mthong ste/ sngon rgya gar gyi dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du mi ro cig bskyal ba la zhag 'ga'i bar du mkha' 'gro/ sha za/ 'byung po/ ce spyang*/ khyi/ wa/ bya'i tshogs mang pos mtha' bskor nas gnas pa la/ paṇ+ḍi ta cig gis mi 'gas gleng ba tshor nas bltar phyin pas/ ro de'i mgul pa na so sor 'brang ma 'khor lo bcu gnyis po 'di yod pa'i phan yon gyis su gang gis kyang reg par ma nus par zhag 'ga' las par snang ngo*// paṇ+ḍi tas srung ba de bkrol ba dang*/

der bya rnams dang gcan gzan gyi tshogs rnams kyis skad cig la zos song bas/ de ngo mtshar nas srung ba bltas pas 'khor lo bcu gnyis ma 'dir 'dug shin tu ngo mtshar bas rdo rje gdan gyi shar sgo'i steng na bris nas bzhag go /des na phyi'i 'khor lo chung ba bcu gnyis/ gtso bo'i 'khor lo dang bcu gsum 'di dgos la/ gtso bo rkyang pa nus pa cung chung bas bcu gsum pa byas na nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo// 'di ma gtogs pa khams gsum na/ srung ba'i rig sngags gzhan med do// mi ro gcig gi mgul pa na// so sor 'brang ma bya ba mthong*// zhes so// phan yon mang po mdo las gong du bkod pa bzhin gsungs so// paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra'i rjes su 'brangs te cung mi gsal ba gsal bar byas te rig sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa zhes bya bas don du gnyer ba'i slob ma mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ shing mo phag gi lo gdu bu zla ba'i gnam gang la 'dan glang thang 'jig rten sgron ma'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru ma hā pra ti sa rā yai/ 'dir 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i srung 'khor rgyas pa phan yon can 'khor lo bcu gsum ma'i bri yig 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin 'bri ba'am spar du btab la/ pho mo'i khyad par gyi rdzas dang dri bzang gis byug de la rab gnas thun mong ba don gsal sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa 'dogs tshul bcas 'dir 'bri na/ srung ba lte ba'i sngags phreng gi zhal rang nyid ngos la bstan pa bzhag de'i mthar mchod pa'i tshogs ci 'byor pa bsham/ de nas stan la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma chu gtsang mas bran la a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum sogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa e h+ye hi/ tsa tur ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭarā ṣa tā ya/ bai ruḍha kā ya/ bi rū pāk+ṣā ya/ be shra wa ṇā ya sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo zhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis phul/ tsa tur ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// sogs gsum/ bsdu na/ dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing*// sgrub la brtson pas sangs rgyas thugs su chud// thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa'i// bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud// ces pa'i mthar/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas te bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng du pram̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas slar 'dus te pram̐ la thim pas rkyen byas nas yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun so sor 'brang ma chen mo gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas zhal nag pa/ rgyab zhal ser ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams kyis rdo rje zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/

spyi bor mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab yol can/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ dbus su pad zla la pram̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas so sor 'brang ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra a lo ke/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥgong ltar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs la dbang bar byas nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// des skyo na thugs ka'i pram̐ gyi tha ma la ma ṇi dha ri'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang yon tan rnams 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bdag dang bsgrub bya la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la gong ltar mchod nas/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin mchog

/dung dang kun+da'i mdog dang mtshungs// so sor 'brang mar phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang mas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad du gsol zhes 'dod don zhu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas khrus sna kun 'dus kyi bum pa yod na bum bskyed mi dgos/ med na tshe dpag med sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin las bum bsgrub/ zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ drag po'i sbyong ba rnams rab gnas kyi gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ 'dir 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i srung ba'i 'khor lor rab gnas bgyid pa la zhes dang*/ bden bdar gyi tshe/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ zhes sbyar/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs nas/ bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā bar sdig pa sbyong ba dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa kyis dri ma sbyong ba rab gnas bzhin rgyas pa'am/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ dag pas 'dod chags sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang*/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sku phyi bcas khrus gsol mdor bsdus kyis rung*/ de nas 'khor lo a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khor lo'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir mu khyud gnyis/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i mtshams bzhi la rdo rje rgya gram gyi phyogs bzhi'i rwa/ de'i phyir pad 'dab nyer lnga/ de'i phyir mu khyud gsum/ de'i phyir gnyis/ de'i phyir pad 'dab lnga bcu rtsa drug de'i phyir mu khyud kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'khor lo'i phyi rol shar lho'i zur gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa/

de'i g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ g.yon du pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lho nub kyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud gnyis pa/ g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ g.yon du pad+ma 'dab drug nub byang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa/ g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ g.yon du 'khor lo rtsibs lnga/ byang shar gyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa/ g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ g.yon du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de rnams kyi phyir mu khyud gcig gis bskor ba dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo dbus ma'i mu khyud bcu pa'i nang du/ pad+ma'i nang du phyag mtshan rin po che/ 'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan/ mda'/ gzhu/ phur pa/ dung*/ mi mgo rdo rje/ gdugs/ dpal be'u/ tho ba/ rtse gsum/ s+t+wa gri/ gri gug ral gri/ rgya gram/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ nya/ bum pa/ pad+ma/ dbyug to/ mdung*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ lnga/ drug brgyad/ brag ri/ gtun shing rnams la dar gyi lda ldis brgyan pa/ bcu gnyis pa la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ 'khor lo bcu gsum pa thams cad kyi phyir ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo'i steng gi yig 'bru rnams pram̐ las 'khor lo pram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo nas/ hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar gong bdag bskyed bzhin dang*/ snying ga'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i pram̐ dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ yang thugs kar sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lus ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis gang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ de nas/ oṃ ma hā pra ti sa re sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kun+da'i 'od dang mtshungs// so sor 'brang mar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ rab gnas bzhin kun mkhyen ye shes sogs sngags dang bcas pas spyan dbye byas la/ de nas ming spel bsrung bya gang yin du bskyed de/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya

rdo rje nang bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs te brkyang*/ mthe bong gshibs te brkyangs pas gung mo mnan pa'i phyag rgya/ dang bcas pas rang ngam/ bsgrub bya'am/ yul grong la sogs pa bkug nas sngar bskyed pa rnams la thim par bsgom/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba datra/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ oṃ a mṛ ta wa re wa ra wa ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bhe saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya wa re a mṛ ta bi ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+ri ya ba le bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba po la nad gdon shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta dha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi ma le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dza ya wa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'chang ba po zhes sogs/ oṃ ni suṃ bha badz+rī ṇi dha ra ka s+ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a pa rā dzi te ma hā de bī traṭa/ oṃ kā la kar+ṇi kṛta/ oṃ pad+ma kuṇ+ḍa li pam̐/ oṃ puṣ+pa dan+ti ni hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇ+yaṃ gu sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shriṃ kha le hūm̐/ oṃ shwe te bam̐/ oṃ ma hā shwe te hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lī hrīḥ oṃ dū ti tuṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī le hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra pā she hoḥ oṃ badz+ra be she bhṛ ta/ oṃ badz+ra bā ṇi ma hā ba le dhīḥ oṃ badz+ra mā le mām̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/

oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsun+dī hrīḥ oṃ su waṇ+ṇa ke she kri ta/ oṃ piṃ ga le lam̐/ oṃ bid+yun+mā li ni dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐/ oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ba la bar+dha ni hā/ oṃ suṃ bha ka ri hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa mā la dha ri hrīḥ oṃ ma hā pra ti sā re pram̐/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ hu ru hu ru hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ ba la bar+dha ni hoḥ oṃ ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re/ 'chang ba po la/ oṃ tā re tām̐/ oṃ dzaḥ oṃ rak+ṣa saṃ ka dza ṭa kham̐/ oṃ bud+dha rak+ṣi ni he hūm̐/ oṃ ka pā li ni hūm̐/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa re kha/ oṃ dha n+ye lam̐/ oṃ laṃ ka shwa ri mu/ oṃ hā ri tī ham̐ k+ṣīṃ/ oṃ pañtsi ke dzoṃ/ oṃ li khe sham̐ ru ṭa/ oṃ ku ṭa dan+di ni kuṭa/ oṃ shrī ya de bī shrīṃ/ oṃ sa ra swa tī bam̐/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ 'chang ba po la sarba rak+ṣa/ sarba bha ye bh+yo bh+rūm̐/ oṃ de wī shrī/ oṃ pad+me bām̐/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ lo tsa ne lām̐/ oṃ mā ma kī mam̐/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa re pam̐/ oṃ ba su dha ri bam̐/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ oṃ bhṛ ku ṭi bh+riṃ/ hūm̐bhūm̐ aḥ oṃ sa/ u sha/ pa lam̐/ k+ṣa k+ṣa/ dhu e/ twa bh+rum̐/ ka kha/ ha bam̐/ dzi bam̐/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ra hūm̐/ lam̐ hrīḥ sum̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥbam̐/ su hūm̐/ oṃ phaṭ/ dzaḥpam̐/ mām̐ ka bam̐ oṃ/ su bha/ bam̐ oṃ/ tri k+ṣa/ ha dhaṃ/ sham̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ saṃ/ hūm̐/ ho oṃ/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ rī/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha/ rten 'brel snying po/ tām̐/ oṃ ka s+ya rak+ṣa swā hā/ rak+ṣa dha ra 'chang ba/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ rai/ swā hā/ hūm̐ sam̐ gam̐ bh+rūm̐ mam̐/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ hūm̐ oṃ dz+riṃ kham̐ hūm̐/

oṃ nī lām+ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rādzña pa ya ti swā hā/ dha ra ka s+ya rak+ṣa/ mam̐ gam̐ hūm̐ bam̐ pam̐/ dhīḥ oṃ a ra pa tsa na/ oṃ ka s+ya rak+ṣa dha ra rak+ṣa phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pram̐ gam̐ hūm̐ sam̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ oṃ mam̐ dzam̐ pram̐ kham̐ tām̐ bh+rūm̐ lam̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+na bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'chang ba po la gnod pa thams cad srungs shig gam̐ pam̐ sam̐ hūm̐ mam̐/ pam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a a/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ ts+tshiṇ+ḍa ts+tshiṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐ bhin+da bhin+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ de lta bu'i sngags rnams ji ltar rigs par bzlas la rdor thal sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang mas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i bar chad thams cad bsrungs shing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma'i sku de nyid zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bris pa'i rnam par gyur/ de'i mtshan dang dpe byad rnams zhu nas dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ger gyur te/ bris pa'i 'khor lo rnams kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma rtsibs mu khyud sogs la gnas par gyur/ ces brjod la mchod/ mnyam med mas bstod/ brtan bzhugs kyi tshig brjod/ ye dharmā dang bkra shis brjod la/ srung ba la me tog gtor/ de ltar rab gnas legs par byas pa'i srung ba de nyid g.yon g.yas 'og steng rnams nas lteb ma chag par bltabs la/

rgyas par na dkar/ sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang gu'i chings dang*/ bsdu na dar dkar po gang rung gi skud pas rgya gram du bcing*/ dri bzang thor bu dang bcas pa'i na bza' lnga brtsegs sam dkar pos bsgril/ 'khor lo dbus ma'i lte ba'i yig mgo ma nor bar byas la slar yang rab gnas mdor bsdus bya/ gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang byed na srung ba lnga'i gras su 'khor lo ster ran pa dang de sbyin/ dus gzhan du gang la ster ba de mdun du bos la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa 'bogs tshul dang*/ srung ba gdags pa'i 'don bya gdugs dkar la sngags sogs kha bsgyur bas bya/ spyi bor bzhag ste/ byabs srung las 'byung ba ltar srungs shig ces pa'i tshig rnams brjod/ sngar bshad pa ltar gyi srung ba de lta bu sbyin bdag gi mgul du gdags/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog dang bcas pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sngags tshar gcig gi mthar/ lha dang brgya byin dang bcas pa// sangs rgyas kyis khyod bde legs shog /dus kun du ni ston par shog /'byung po thams cad bde legs shog /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag ni// lha rnams kyi ni stobs kyis kyang*// don ni gang dang gang 'dod pa// don ni thams cad 'grub par shog /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /lam du zhugs rnams bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /khyed cag kun kyang bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun// 'byung po dag ni thams cad kyang*// thams cad bde legs 'ba' zhig shog /thams cad nad ni med gyur cig /kun gyis bzang po mthong bar shog /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /ston mchog dam pa sogs dang*/ 'byung po gang dag sogs dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bcom ldan so sor 'brang ma'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin pas// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig

/ces dang*// nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod la bsgrub bya rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gnas gsum bsrungs te dge bsngo shis brjod ci rigs par bya'o// 'khor ba'i 'jigs dang sdug bsngal las// 'chang ba tsam gyis grol byed pa'i// rig pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag gis// don kun yongs su grub gyur cig /ces pa'ang rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'phro la dgos pa'i kha skong gi yig cha lag tu len bde bar blo gter dbang pos bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
